tooltip.carrote_curios.unique: Active in either hand or any accessory slot. Identical effects do not stack.
tooltip.carrote_curios.offhand: Without Curios: hold in either hand to activate.
tooltip.carrote_curios.airborne_carrote: Damage x2 while airborne; x0.5 while grounded.
tooltip.carrote_curios.greed_carrote: Loot uses at least Fortune III and Looting III; tools are unchanged.
tooltip.carrote_curios.enchanting_carrot: Enchanting tables use at least 15 bookshelves; XP and lapis are still required.
tooltip.carrote_curios.smelting_carrote: Automatically smelts mined ore drops, preserving Fortune quantities.
tooltip.carrote_curios.tasty_carrote: Prevents exhaustion from consuming hunger or saturation; does not refill them.
tooltip.carrote_curios.flight_carrote: Grants creative flight. Double-tap jump; removed when unequipped.
tooltip.carrote_curios.arcane_carrote: Enchanting or combining enchantments in an anvil adds 1 level, beyond vanilla limits.
tooltip.carrote_curios.steel_carrote: Blocks one hit, including /kill. Shared player cooldown: 10 seconds.
